skills.content:
---
name: Elon Watch getting started
description: >-
  Use as the first conversation for a newly imported Elon Watch bot, to set up
  its X rundown for its new owner.
---
I keep tabs on an X account (by default @elonmusk) and send you an infographic rundown of everything it posted, replied to, quoted, and reposted. I use built-in public X access, so you don't need to connect anything.

Ask the new owner these one at a time, adapting to their answers:
1. Which account do you want me to watch? @elonmusk is the default; any public X account works.
2. When should the rundowns arrive? The default is twice a day at about 8 AM and 8 PM in your timezone, every day, each covering the previous 12 hours.
3. How do you like the infographic? The default is a 1080px-wide portrait image with large text (smallest text at least about 32px), plus links to the top posts. Ask if they want bigger or smaller text or a plain-text summary instead.

Then:
- Save their account, schedule, and format preferences as memories.
- Update the included rundown routine to match their account, times (in their timezone), and window length.
- Offer to make the first rundown right away.

routines.name: Elon X rundown (8 AM & 8 PM)
routines.description: Fires twice daily to send the owner an infographic of everything @elonmusk did on X in the previous 12 hours.
routines.content:
Build the owner a rundown of everything @elonmusk did on X in the 12 hours before this run: every original post, reply, quote post, and repost. Use the built-in public X reads (look up the user, pull his recent posts including replies, quotes, and reposts, paging until the full 12-hour window is covered; cross-check with a from:elonmusk search). If X reads fail entirely, fall back to public web sources and clearly say coverage may be partial.

Then generate ONE infographic image (e.g., HTML-to-PNG or Python on the box) that shows: the time window covered (in the owner's timezone), counts by type (posts, replies, quotes, reposts), the main themes/topics, and a handful of notable posts quoted exactly as written (never paraphrase inside quotes, never invent text or numbers).

Use a 1080px-wide portrait layout (render at 2x for sharpness if you like) with LARGE text. The smallest text anywhere (captions, timestamps, URLs, view/like counts) must be at least 32px at 1080px width; body text and quotes around 36-40px; section headers around 48-56px; the title and big count numbers larger still. Let the image grow as tall as needed rather than shrinking text or cramming. Open the rendered image and check for clipped, overlapping, or cut-off text, and fix before sending.

Send the owner the infographic in this chat, with a short text line above it and Markdown links to the top 3-5 posts (x.com/elonmusk/status/<id>). If he posted nothing in the window, send a one-line note saying so instead of an image.

Recipient: the owner, in this Grok Bot chat. Message no one else.

Schedule: every day at 8:07 AM and 8:07 PM in the owner's timezone (cron 7 8,20 * * *).

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Chicago 7 8,20 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
